This dataset contains six (6) las files created from one thousand and seventy-five (1075) images collected by a DJI Phantom 4 Pro UAV and processed in Pix4D of the Frank Slide Interpretation Centre by Geomatics Engineering students at the School of Construction, Southern Alberta Institute of Technology, 2020-06-05.
